confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough triangulations from Numbeo Cusco pages and several travel-cost and guide sites. Sources conflict, and some are dated to 2025. The cocktail anchor rests on a few Cusco pisco sour reports. The wine glass anchor is inferred at about twice the beer anchor, with one reported Cusco restaurant glass price as a rough check, not a direct average. Mid-range meal prices vary widely between local and upscale venues. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates for the July 2026 high season from general knowledge; no booking pages or live listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Cusco-specific and cross-checked against Peru-wide guide figures. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Cusco's tourist market and is not benchmarked to another city.
